summary: [Jobber] webhooks: subscribe with topics (CLIENT_CREATE/UPDATE, JOB_UPDATE, INVOICE_UPDATE, INVOICE_PAID, VISIT_COMPLETE/UPDATE...). Payload {data:{webHookEvent:{topic, appId, accountId, itemId, occurredAt}}}; at-least-once with retries on non-200; HMAC-verify, resolve itemId -> client, always 200 (silent 200 for unknown tenants); dedupe by (topic, itemId, occurredAt).
